name: Elven Archer
who: an elven archer, a slender young female wood elf with long blonde hair in two braids, pointed ears and green eyes, in a white linen shirt with full sleeves under a laced olive-green vest, a brown belt, dark red leather bracers, dark red leggings and tall dark red boots
stow: She has no bow: it is left out of the picture entirely, and nothing is slung across her back but the quiver. Both hands are empty and open.
